bio_en: Ghazar Makunts was a disciplined ARF soldier who went without hesitation wherever the party sent him, regarding its instructions as sacred. Like his generation he spent his life wandering, at times in Persia during the constitutional movement and elsewhere. He remained active in the Armenian community of Iran. He died in December 1967, mourned in a eulogy by Yer. Hayrapetian in Alik.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Only the opening of the eulogy was read; dates and places are sparse.
